name: Young Parent Payment
description: A welfare benefit for young parents under 20 with dependent children, subject to activity obligations and youth money management, with provisions for exemptions, sanctions, and transitions.

attributes.summary: A welfare benefit for young parents under 20 with dependent children, subject to activity obligations and youth money management, with provisions for exemptions, sanctions, and transitions.
attributes.eligibility: Young parent must be under 20 years old with a dependent child. Residence and immigration status requirements apply. Income criteria and activity obligations must be met.
attributes.payment_details: Payment includes youth money management, incentive payments, and redirection of funds with provisions for exemptions and sanctions.
attributes.obligations: Young parents must meet activity requirements including parenting, education, training, and work-based learning. Obligations apply to changes in circumstances including absence from New Zealand, child changes, hospitalisation, imprisonment, and income treatment.
attributes.stand_down: Initial stand-down periods apply with provisions for absence from New Zealand, child changes, and other qualifying events.
attributes.income_test: Income abatement applies with treatment of income from various sources and activity-related considerations.
